Human Evaluation. Following Zhang and Song (2022), we evaluate generated texts from three aspects. Relevance (Rel.) reflects the degree of achievement for the desired control attribute. Fluency (Flu.) evaluates the text's fluency from the human perspective. Topicality (Top.) evaluate the consistency between the generated text and the input prompt. For each task, we randomly select 100 texts and ask three annotators to score them on the three metrics on a scale from 1 (very bad) to 5 (very good).
